method: Original full pages at1500px and original page1 applicant-panel crop at180dpi reviewed before any product inspection for this new gold. Row-major order of fourteen distinct visible field identifiers, top to bottom and left to right within a row. Source dictionaries/ToUnicode/font programs not consulted for declaration; no rendered glyph/font binaries saved to Git.
privacy: Original public form/instructions with blank areas and specimen X/era/circle/triangle placeholders, no observed real applicant details. QR code and links not followed.
scope: Selected printed field-ID sequence only. Not complete table text, semantic cell association, whitespace, global page order, filled values, form extraction, tax advice, or document precision/recall. Existing vertical-note reading gold remains separate and must stay enforced.
